subject: infra.cybersec
name: National computer emergency response team and security operations centre
what_would_settle_it: The ANINF or ministerial act creating a national incident response team, or an ANINF activity report stating whether the centre and team that SecBOM is designed to feed are in operation

subject: infra.energy
name: Grid supply position for data-centre load
what_would_settle_it: A national utility or energy ministry supply statement, or the two facilities' grid-connection agreements, establishing available and firm capacity against the more than 2 MW of Tier III load committed by end-2026

subject: infra.capacity
name: Information and communications technology workforce measure
what_would_settle_it: An ANINF or ministry workforce return, or enrolment data from the training institutions named at the technical committee of 2026-07-31, giving a countable figure for Gabonese technical capacity

subject: data.statistics
name: Recensement general de la population et de l'habitat
what_would_settle_it: The census report or a statistics office release giving the enumeration date, published population and dissemination status; the base knows the census exists only because the 2026 social census plans to reuse its data

subject: data.statistics
name: National statistical office output
what_would_settle_it: Any dated release, statistical yearbook or dataset from the national statistics office; the section currently rests entirely on central-bank and bank-association figures

subject: dpi.pay
name: National platform for the payment and collection of public revenue
what_would_settle_it: The decree, operator contract or launch communique naming the platform announced at the ministerial session of 2026-01-13, which has produced nothing since

subject: dpi.pay
name: Electronic invoicing mandate
what_would_settle_it: The tax instruction or finance-law article setting the mandate date, taxpayer thresholds and platform, announced at the same session of 2026-01-13

subject: gov.protect
name: Authority's authorisation for biometric identity-card processing
what_would_settle_it: A published deliberation or authorisation of the data-protection authority under article 76, or a register of authorisations listing it; the identity-card programme has run three years and article 219 gave no grace period

subject: gov.regional
name: Position under the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection
what_would_settle_it: The African Union list of signatures, ratifications and accessions, or a Gabonese ratification law and its instrument of deposit

subject: data.open
name: Open government data portal or policy
what_would_settle_it: A national open-data portal, a published open-data policy or directive, or a dataset catalogue; the base holds no Gabonese source on this subject at all

subject: geopol.eu
name: European Union digital cooperation instrument
what_would_settle_it: A Global Gateway country package, a bilateral digital cooperation agreement or a Team Europe initiative document; the base carries no Gabonese source on this subject at all

subject: gov.policy
name: National digital strategy document
what_would_settle_it: The named strategy text or the digital chapter of the national development and growth plan for 2026-2030, with its adoption date and horizon; the base holds programme labels and budget lines but no strategy document

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: National artificial-intelligence strategy or policy
what_would_settle_it: A published national strategy, policy, ethics framework or roadmap, or a ministerial statement that none is planned; the only artefact the wiki holds from Gabon on the subject is the minister's own commentary arguing against an early strategy

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Deployed artificial-intelligence system or use-case register
what_would_settle_it: Any named operational system in Gabonese government or industry, or a ministry inventory of them; the base names artificial intelligence only as a category in curricula, a data-centre room and workshop agendas

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Artificial-intelligence compute capacity
what_would_settle_it: A processor count, accelerated-compute figure or dedicated power allocation for either Tier III facility; both are described as capable of it and neither has a compute figure on file

subject: tech.innovate
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Start-up labelling criteria and register
what_would_settle_it: The labelling criteria document and the list of firms labelled under Kimba Connect; the label makes the ministry the arbiter of which firms count as credible counterparties, and nothing on its criteria, committee or a single labelled firm is held

subject: tech.industry
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Digital sector economic weight
what_would_settle_it: A national accounts series, ministry statistical annex or regulator market report giving the sector's share of gross domestic product, firm count or employment; the base holds penetration figures and an organisers' estimate of start-up numbers, and nothing measured

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Indian digital or technology cooperation instrument
what_would_settle_it: Any memorandum, line of credit, training-programme participation or Indian supplier contract naming Gabon; the base returns no source at this intersection

subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Gulf-state digital or technology cooperation instrument
what_would_settle_it: Any investment, data-centre agreement or sovereign-fund commitment naming Gabon; the base returns no source at this intersection

subject: include.divides
name: Universal service fund
what_would_settle_it: The regulator or ministerial instrument creating the fund, its levy base, its disbursements and its coverage targets; the record holds only a statement that universal-service initiatives run with the regulator

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Named national digital-literacy programme
what_would_settle_it: The national strategy for the digitalisation of teaching, or a ministerial programme document with a cohort target; digital literacy is named as a budget axis with no programme behind it

subject: capacity.training
name: Public digital-training institutions under the ministry
what_would_settle_it: The ministry's organisation decree listing the institutions under its supervision, or an annual report from any one of them

subject: capacity.training
name: Connected schools programme
what_would_settle_it: The Huawei memorandum of 2025-12-23, or a supplier or ministry statement giving the school count, the equipment supplied and the expansion terms; the programme is named only as one to be expanded

subject: include.divides
name: Gender digital divide
what_would_settle_it: A published gender-gap figure for Gabon, or the Digital Gabon results framework reporting an actual against its target of 50,000 female beneficiaries, still at a zero baseline

subject: include.divides
name: Rural and urban internet access split
what_would_settle_it: A regulator quarterly observatory with provincial coverage, or a census digital-access module; only the national urban population share is held

subject: finance.budget
name: Enacted digital appropriation for 2026
what_would_settle_it: The finance law for 2026 as gazetted, showing the ministry's voted line against the XAF 82bn presented in October 2025

subject: capacity.research
name: Named national research funding for digital technology or artificial intelligence
what_would_settle_it: A research council or higher-education ministry programme document or budget line; the only capacity finance the base holds closed in 2023

subject: gov.standards
name: Enforcement of service-quality obligations
what_would_settle_it: a regulator quality-of-service determination, decision or sanction would settle it; probed 2026-08-25, reporting of that date states that at a departmental capital the incumbent sells data bundles on a network whose coverage appears and disappears while prepaid credit and bundle validity run down normally, and puts the regulator inaction to the president of its regulatory council; no determination, decision or sanction is published
